purpose: V6-A core engine plus V6-B dynamic theme sleeve with portfolio-level dynamic GLD/BIL overlay.

v6b_profile.description: ETF theme discovery -> theme-to-stock expression; top3 themes; guarded risk controls; 90% risk weight inside V6-B sleeve.

dynamic_overlay.hedge_selection_rule: Use GLD when GLD is above its 126-day moving average; otherwise use BIL.
dynamic_overlay.overlay_policy: Overlay is not permanent. It only reallocates part of A/B risk budget when market, volatility, drawdown, or correlation triggers fire.

known_weaknesses: Sharpe is around 1.14, below the desired 1.2+ quality bar.
2018Q4, 2020 COVID shock, and 2022 hike bear windows are still negative.
Simple V6-B momentum/drawdown off-switch did not improve results and should not be used in v1.

required_monitoring: current drawdown versus candidate max drawdown
stop_or_review_conditions: A/B rolling 63-day correlation >= 0.75 while SPY or QQQ is below 200-day moving average
V6-B sleeve loses more than 8% from local peak while overlay is inactive
any execution mismatch between intended sleeve weights and paper orders
